entries.title: Job 11:1
segments: ¶Then Zophar the Naamathite answered and said:

entries.title: Job 11:2
segments: "Should not the multitude of words be answered? And should a man full of talk be vindicated?

entries.title: Job 11:3
segments: Should your empty talk make men hold their peace? And when you mock, should no one rebuke you?

entries.title: Job 11:4
segments: For you have said, 'My doctrine [is] pure, And I am clean in your eyes.'

entries.title: Job 11:5
segments: But oh, that God would speak, And open His lips against you,

entries.title: Job 11:6
segments: That He would show you the secrets of wisdom! For [they would] double [your] prudence. Know therefore that God exacts from you [Less] than your iniquity [deserves].

entries.title: Job 11:7
segments: ¶"Can you search out the deep things of God? Can you find out the limits of the Almighty?

entries.title: Job 11:8
segments: [They are] higher than heaven-what can you do? Deeper than Sheol-what can you know?

entries.title: Job 11:9
segments: Their measure [is] longer than the earth And broader than the sea.

entries.title: Job 11:10
segments: "If He passes by, imprisons, and gathers [to judgment], Then who can hinder Him?

entries.title: Job 11:11
segments: For He knows deceitful men; He sees wickedness also. Will He not then consider [it]?

entries.title: Job 11:12
segments: For an empty-headed man will be wise, When a wild donkey's colt is born a man.

entries.title: Job 11:13
segments: ¶"If you would prepare your heart, And stretch out your hands toward Him;

entries.title: Job 11:14
segments: If iniquity [were] in your hand, [and you] put it far away, And would not let wickedness dwell in your tents;

entries.title: Job 11:15
segments: Then surely you could lift up your face without spot; Yes, you could be steadfast, and not fear;

entries.title: Job 11:16
segments: Because you would forget [your] misery, And remember [it] as waters [that have] passed away,

entries.title: Job 11:17
segments: And [your] life would be brighter than noonday. [Though] you were dark, you would be like the morning.

entries.title: Job 11:18
segments: And you would be secure, because there is hope; Yes, you would dig [around you, and] take your rest in safety.

entries.title: Job 11:19
segments: You would also lie down, and no one would make [you] afraid; [Yes], many would court your favor.

entries.title: Job 11:20
segments: But the eyes of the wicked will fail, And they shall not escape, And their hope-loss of life!"
